LESSON: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What do you do before eating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. Practise: demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do before eating?
2. What is the benefit of saying Bismillah while eating?
